interpretation: Stage-specific sample loss is not a viable explanation and the observed total genus-adjusted attenuation remains large. However, paired spatial-block uncertainty does not precisely localize the incremental attenuation at the family-to-genus transition: all eight direct-only 95% intervals for the additional family-to-genus attenuation include zero.
manuscript_rule: Do not describe the family-to-genus incremental attenuation as precisely estimated. P1c remains a separate test of whether true genus boundaries outperform arbitrary within-family partitions of matched complexity.
claim_boundary: This result does not reclassify historical H3, does not identify causal assembly, and does not determine the P1c matched-complexity outcome.
